newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Graboplast says Q2 bettered fine Q1.
newsitem.headline: Graboplast says Q2 bettered fine Q1.

text.p: Hungarian home improvement product maker group Graboplast Rt said on Saturday it had followed an outstanding first quarter with a far better second quarter.
"The second quarter was substantially better than our outstandingly good first quarter," Graboplast's Chairman Peter Jancso told a news conference. "This refers both to sales and profit."

In the first quarter of the year the Graboplast group generated a consolidated pre-tax profit of 581.9 million forints, and after-tax profit of 475.5 million forints on net sales of 4.020 billion forints.
Budapest Stock Exchange listed companies have to submit their second quarter earnings reports to the bourse by August 15.
For the third quarter of 1997, Jancso said the group expected a pre-tax profit of over 800 million forints on sales of above six billion forints.
"The third is the strongest quarter for a company which operates on this (home improvement product) market," he said.
